newsitem.title: USA: Chantal ends marketing pact with Stanson.
newsitem.headline: Chantal ends marketing pact with Stanson.

text.p: Chantal Pharmaceutical Corp said Monday that it has reached an agreement in principle to terminate its marketing agreement with its U.S. distributor, Stanson Marketing Inc.

Chantal said that Stanson will receive 1.2 million shares of Chantal stock and the limited right to sell off a portion of its current inventory of Chantal Skin Care Products. The rest of those products wil be returned to Chantal.
Chantal stock traded up 1/4 Monday afternoon at 1-1/4.
The company said that the deal would have no impact on its financial statement, and that Stanson's limited distribution rights would not interfere with its own distribution program.
The company also named five new members to its board of directors as part of a restructuring, including entertainer and businesswoman Polly Bergen, who will become chief operating oficer.
